Terms of Use & Full Disclaimer

1. Nature of the Information

The data, maps, tenement shapes, company attributions, application statuses, and related metadata presented on this service (the "Service") are compiled from public extracts and third-party feeds for general convenience. The Service does not provide legal, spatial, tenement management, mining, geological, tax, or financial advice. The presentation of tenement data does not imply that an exploration licence (EL), assessment lease, mining lease, or application is valid, granted, in good standing, uncontested, or free of competing priority rights.

2. Statutory Register Primacy & Verification

The official source of mining title information in New South Wales is the NSW Mining Titles Register administered under the Mining Act 1992 (NSW).

  • Data presented here may not reflect real-time register amendments, renewals, cancellations, surrenders, transfers, caveats, native title claims, or pending objections.
  • Users must conduct formal, independent searches directly through official departmental channels (such as NSW Resources / MinView / the Mining Titles Register) and obtain independent legal and title opinions before taking any commercial, statutory, or operational steps.

3. Spatial Accuracy, Boundaries, and Land Access

  • No Cadastral Authority: Boundary layers, coordinates, and polygon extents are schematic and indicative only. They are not legal boundary determinations, are not prepared by a registered surveyor, and cannot be used to establish boundary location on the ground.
  • Land Access Restrictions: The depiction of a tenement or application over an area does not imply right of physical entry. Users must comply with all statutory landholder notification and access agreement requirements under the Mining Act 1992 (NSW), crown land restrictions, national park protections, and the Native Title Act 1993 (Cth). The operator of this Service accepts no liability for civil or criminal trespass, property damage, or breach of access regulations.

4. Company & Commercial Data

Company names, contact points, beneficial interests, joint venture representations, and ASX codes displayed alongside tenements are aggregated from external registers (e.g., ASIC, corporate disclosures). The Service makes no representation regarding the accuracy of corporate structures, farm-in agreements, beneficial ownership, or operational operator status.

5. Exclusion of Warranties

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law (including Schedule 2 of the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) / Australian Consumer Law), this Service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis without warranties of any kind, whether express, statutory, or implied, including but not limited to:
